title: Context as a Resource
abstract: arXiv:2611.26346v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Managing concurrent tasks across separate agent sessions quickly exhausts human attention, motivating always-on personal agents behind a single continuous interface. Yet when every context shares identical frozen backbone weights, funneling interleaved dialogues and external events into one linear session induces cross-topic constraint bleed and head-of-line stalling. Conversely, router-ticket hierarchies incur lossy prose handoffs, heavy routing overhead, and blind merges - collapsing true-conflict repository merges to a 33.3% three-run mean despite high isolated branch passes. Rather than scheduling anthropomorphic roles, we introduce ClonAct, a routerless architecture that virtualizes context blocks directly through a pluggable single-pass non-generative Context MMU, in-place Context Cells, a footprint-aware Synaptic Bus with an isolated trial merge gate, and a wave-flushed Shared Trunk. translated_abstract: 管理跨独立代理会话的并发任务会迅速耗尽人类注意力，这促使人们需要在一个连续界面背后运行全天候在线的个人代理。然而，当每个上下文共享相同的冻结骨干权重时，将交错的对话和外部事件汇聚到单一的线性会话中，会引发跨主题约束渗漏和队头阻塞。相反，采用路由工单层级结构则会带来有损的文本交接、沉重的路由开销以及盲目合并——尽管孤立分支的通过率很高，但真实存在冲突的代码库合并的三次运行平均成功率却降至33.3%。我们不采用拟人化角色调度的方式，而是提出ClonAct，一种无路由架构，它通过可插拔的单遍非生成式上下文内存管理单元直接虚拟化上下文块，配合原地上下文单元、具有隔离试合并门的足迹感知突触总线，以及波刷新共享主干。在三个程序化多流基准测试上……
tldr: 提出无路由架构ClonAct，通过非生成式上下文内存管理单元、原地上下文单元、足迹感知突触总线和波刷新共享主干直接虚拟化上下文块，解决多代理并发会话中的跨主题约束渗漏与盲目合并失败问题。
en_tdlr: ClonAct, a routerless architecture that virtualizes context blocks directly through a non-generative Context MMU, in-place Context Cells, a footprint-aware Synaptic Bus with an isolated trial merge gate, and a wave-flushed Shared Trunk, addressing cross-topic constraint bleed and blind merge failures in concurrent multi-agent sessions.
